sourceFile: 11.BRS-201506 Report checking problem process NG high date 2.2.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable data but the changed-factor and outcome grouping are not reliable enough for final evidence.
issues: Changed factor is nonsensical and mixes dates, totals, row numbers, AWF IDs, and test settings.
Baseline/test logic is not captured; normal line vs Z-axis/delay tests appears relevant for pickup data.
Unrelated sections and sheets are merged under one factor without preserving process context.
Dimension extraction likely uses width spec for length, creating false violations.
Headers, purpose rows, and totals are treated as evidence conditions.
requiredUserQuestions: Should sheets 25.5 and Report 13.11 be separate review cases or one workbook-level report?
correctionPlan: Rebuild cases by section or sheet before final use.
Define each primary changed factor from source context, not candidate tokens.
Keep dates, machine, AWF, item test, Z-axis, delay, and note as subgroup keys.
Remove totals and header rows from condition comparisons unless used only as summaries.
Correct dimension specs and remove duplicate measurement tables.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but citations are insufficient for the claimed grouping and need corrected section-level support.
